title: Lena and the Hollow
author: Lena Thornbury
blurb: Edmund Yarrow, the last oath-bound swordspeaker, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then the border wards fall on the same night the stars go out — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must reforge a broken covenant between realms before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
